title: 第1783章 炎阳金焰的另一种妙用第1782章 段丹颖抽空来访
content_zh:
“李前辈，这炎阳金焰对你不会有影响吧？”
叶非凡想起李逍现在就是灵魂状态，所以又赶忙收起灵火，怕伤到对方。
“哼！
我可是将神灵不灭咒修炼到大成的，这点点炎阳金焰算什么，就算更多，我也.......
不对啊，这不是金乌之炎吗？？
怎么叶小友竟然有其火种，并且还是极为纯正的那种。”
李逍先是挺直了身形，打算自吹一番，但随后便更在意叶非凡为何能拥有如此宝物。
“对对！！
不愧是李前辈，阅历深厚，眼光独到！！
这就是金乌之炎，炎阳金焰只是万象道盟内修士对它的一种称呼。”
“不是，我问的是你是怎么得到金乌之炎的火种的，并且还是很纯正的那种。”
说实话，李逍有点怀疑是叶非凡背后的那位仙灵大人赏赐的，也就只有那种存在出手才能如此大方。
“这是炎阳至尊赏赐给晚辈的。
而炎阳至尊的本体就是三足金乌。”
叶非凡快速说道。
“炎阳至尊的本体竟然是三足金乌？？？
这可是极为罕见的存在........”
李逍闻言先是张大了嘴巴，后续又转为一声叹息。
“唉，万象道盟了不得啊，既有覆界焱凤又有三足金乌........”
“李前辈，请问晚辈能用这个炎阳........额........金乌之炎修炼神灵不灭咒吗？”

“可以，既然这三朵火种如此纯正，那么效果也够了。
叶小友不愧是........嗯，机缘当真是非同一般。”
李逍想起段丹颖还在场，说话就有些顾虑。
“多谢李前辈夸赞。
不知晚辈该如何修炼，还望李前辈指点一二。”
叶非凡连忙对着李逍躬身拱手行礼。
“其实很简单，你平常使用炎阳金焰炼丹时，它会自主灼烧你的灵魂，而你之后抽空持续运转神灵不灭咒的法诀就行。
不过这同样是一个循序渐进的过程，不能冲动。
神灵不灭咒是增强你的灵魂防御力，并不是修复你的灵魂损伤，所以如果你太过激进，直接导致灵魂受损，那就不好办了。”
李逍认真的说道。
只需要这样吗？？？
那我岂不是已经在修炼了？？？
content_en:
"Senior Li, this golden sun flame won't have any effect on you, will it?"
Ye Feifan remembered that Li Xiao was in a state of soul, so he quickly put away the spiritual fire for fear of hurting the other party.
"Hmph!
I have practiced the Immortal Curse of the Spirits to great perfection. This little bit of flaming sun golden flame is nothing, even if it is more, I will...
No, isn't this the Flame of the Golden Crow? ?
Why did Ye Xiaoyou actually have his own kind of fire, and it was an extremely pure kind. "
Li Xiao straightened his body at first, planning to brag, but then he became more concerned about why Ye Feifan had such a treasure.
"Yes!!
As expected of Senior Li, he has profound experience and unique vision! !
This is the Flame of the Golden Crow, and the Yanyang Golden Flame is just a name given to it by the monks in the Wanxiang Taoist Alliance. "
"No, what I'm asking is how you got the fire of the Golden Crow Flame, and it's still very pure."
To be honest, Li Xiao had some doubts that it was the fairy spirit behind Ye Feifan who had given it to him. Only that kind of being could be so generous.
“This is a reward from Supreme Yanyang to this junior.
The true form of Yanyang Supreme is the three-legged Golden Crow. "
Ye Feifan said quickly.
“The body of Supreme Yanyang is actually a three-legged golden crow???
This is an extremely rare existence..."
When Li Xiao heard this, he opened his mouth wide at first, and then he sighed.
"Oh, the Wanxiang Taoist Alliance is amazing. It has both the World-Covering Yanfeng and the Three-Legged Golden Crow..."
"Senior Li, can I ask if this junior can use this flaming sun...uh...the golden crow's flame to practice the Immortal God's Curse?"
"Okay, since these three fire seeds are so pure, the effect is enough.
Ye Xiaoyou is indeed...well, the opportunity is really extraordinary. "
Li Xiao remembered that Duan Danying was still there, so he felt a little worried when he spoke.
"Thank you, Senior Li, for the compliment.
I don’t know how this junior should practice, so I hope Senior Li can give me some advice. "
Ye Feifan quickly bowed to Li Xiao and saluted.
"Actually, it's very simple. When you usually use the Golden Flame of the Sun to make elixirs, it will burn your soul on its own, and then you just need to take the time to continue running the magic spell of the God's Immortal Curse.
However, this is also a gradual process and cannot be impulsive.
The Immortality Curse is to enhance your soul's defense, not to repair the damage to your soul, so if you are too aggressive and directly cause damage to your soul, it will be difficult to handle. "
Li Xiao said seriously.
Is that all it takes? ? ?
Then am I already practicing? ? ?
